headline: The Gulf AI story has shifted from building capacity to making it survivable: a day after AWS wrote off its Bahrain region and one UAE zone, Amazon disputed that the sites will never reopen but gave no rebuild commitment, and AGBI reports investors and hyperscalers must now plan for deliberate multi-zone attacks. Saudi buyers are already acting, with CNTXT and Tencent Cloud reporting war-driven multi-cloud demand and Nomu-listed Edarat placing a SAR 127.5m GPU and cloud equipment order with the OEM undisclosed. In Africa, the US DFC put $155m into WIOCC's cables and data centres alongside Saudi-based Vision Invest, explicitly as an alternative to Huawei. Memory keeps tightening: Seoul Economic Daily puts 64GB DDR5 server RDIMM contract prices at $1,500 (5.5 times a year ago), Citi sees tightness lasting until 2031, Omdia shows Africa's sub-$100 smartphone shipments down 34%, and Huawei pulled its Ascend roadmap forward while saying demand exceeds supply.
lenovo_read: Two things should happen this week: turn AWS's damage into sovereign-resilience wins starting with Edarat and CNTXT-type buyers, and secure 2027 memory before server BOMs reprice again, as Goldman's new $1.5tn server-market model (per a secondary summary) shows Dell pulling ahead on AI-server share.

pillars.dc: 5 scored items (Edarat GPU/cloud PO, AWS/Amazon rebuttal, AGBI on war-driven redesign, DFC-WIOCC $155m, $22bn Crux AI chip loan); no new MW build, groundbreaking or land allocation in KSA or GCC in the window, and the 14 GW Saudi story is a pre-window repost.
pillars.memory: 10 scored items; no new TrendForce contract print or 4Q26 forecast. Last contract reference TrendForce 3 Jul 2026: 3Q26 conventional DRAM +13-18% QoQ, NAND +10-15% QoQ (HBM 2027 +70-140%, 25 Aug); DRAMeXchange spot 17 Sep 13:10 KSA: DDR5 16Gb $55.233 (+0.73%), DDR4 16Gb 3200 $86.000 (-1.85%).
pillars.deals: 10 scored items: KSA Edarat-Aklaniyat, Monsha'at-STC Bank, Wipro-Aramco-SAP; GCC/MEA DFC-Vision Invest-AFC-WIOCC, Zain Kuwait-Schneider, du-QuantumGate, DESC-Microsoft, Atos-GCH.
pillars.global: Microsoft (Agent 365 UAE in-country, DESC dashboard), Wipro/SAP (Aramco), Schneider, Atos and Tencent Cloud (KSA demand) scored; Chinese-rule news for Huawei, Tencent, ByteDance, Xiaomi, ZTE, Oppo, Honor, Hisense and Lenovo; Alibaba and Haier items held as unreadable.

stories.title: Edarat issues SAR 127.5M PO for computing infrastructure equipment
stories.published: 16 Sep 2026 (earliest pickup Mubasher 16:07 KSA; Al-Eqtisadiah 17:27 KSA; Tadawul/Nomu filing time not verified)
stories.summary: Nomu-listed Edarat Communication & IT issued a purchase order worth SAR 127.54m (excluding VAT) to Aklaniyat Technology Co. for cloud and GPU computing infrastructure under its EdaratCloud Stack plan, approved by the board on 9 Sep. Delivery runs in five phases over six months, financed through supplier credit and local bank facilities. Assets will be recognised in Q4 2026 and Q1 2027 and depreciated over five years.
bullets: Edarat issued a purchase order on Sept. 16 to Aklaniyat Technology Co. Ltd. for cloud and GPU-based computing infrastructure equipment totaling SAR 127.54 million, excluding VAT.
The order will be funded through supplier financing with Aklaniyat and credit facilities, and supplied and commissioned in five phases over the next six months.
The capital assets will be recognized in Q4 2026 and Q1 2027 and depreciated over five years, following a Sept. 9 board decision approving the EdaratCloud Stack strategic plan.
stories.lenovo: ISG: A Saudi sovereign-cloud provider is buying GPU infrastructure right now through a local reseller, following Edarat's SAR 197.8m design contract for a 200MW AI data centre (9 Sep). OEM undisclosed, so this is an open ISG opportunity; Aklaniyat is a channel Lenovo should be inside, and supplier financing suits Lenovo's financial-services and TruScale offers. Action: the ISG KSA channel team should establish this week which OEM sits behind the PO and whether later phases are still open.
stories.arabic: شركة إدارات تصدر أمر شراء بقيمة 127.5 مليون ريال لمعدات الحوسبة السحابية ووحدات معالجة الرسومات من شركة عقلانيات للتقنية، على خمس مراحل خلال ستة أشهر ضمن خطة EdaratCloud Stack.

stories.title: War fears lead to AI revenue growth in Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: AGBI reports war-driven AI and cloud demand in the Kingdom. CNTXT, the Aramco-Cognite joint venture, says revenue is running ahead of plan as clients seek multiple cloud providers after the AWS damage in Bahrain and the UAE, and Tencent Cloud MENA, which holds the Class C licence for top-secret data and a Saudi data centre, reports similar demand. Salesforce's Mohammed Alkhotani cites the high end of triple-digit growth in the Kingdom over the past year.
bullets: CNTXT, a joint venture between Saudi Aramco and Norwegian AI company Cognite, has doubled its revenue every year since it was established in 2022.
Tencent Cloud Mena acquired the Class C licence required to handle top-secret data and launched its first data centre in Saudi Arabia last year.
Salesforce's Mohammed Alkhotani said the company saw the high end of triple digit growth in Saudi Arabia over the past year.
stories.lenovo: ISG/SSG: First-hand evidence that the AWS outage is turning into Saudi multi-cloud and on-prem spending. Tencent Cloud is positioning to capture that demand with in-Kingdom capacity, Chinese infrastructure competing for the same resilience budget as Lenovo ISG hybrid offers. CNTXT is a priority prospect for Lenovo's industrial-AI edge and sovereign cloud stack.
stories.arabic: أجبي: مخاوف الحرب تسرّع إيرادات الذكاء الاصطناعي في السعودية، إذ تقول سنتكست إن إيراداتها تتجاوز الخطة مع سعي العملاء لتعدد مزودي السحابة، وتينسنت كلاود ترصد طلباً متزايداً.

stories.title: Monsha'at, STC Bank Sign Cooperation Agreement with SAR5 Billion Financing Portfolio
stories.published: SPA 17 Sep 2026 13:19 KSA (Ajel 11:16 KSA, Al Arabiya 11:26); signed at Money20/20 Middle East 14-16 Sep, exact day not stated
stories.summary: Monsha'at, the SME authority, and STC Bank agreed a Sharia-compliant SME financing portfolio of up to SAR 5bn with tenors of up to 10 years. STC Bank's Money20/20 wrap-up (Okaz) says it signed 28 agreements and MoUs, with partners including Huawei, Moyasar, Paylink, UnionPay, Network International and Hala.
bullets: Monsha'at signed the agreement with STC Bank on the sidelines of the Money20/20 conference in Riyadh.
The agreement provides Sharia-compliant financing solutions through a portfolio valued at up to SAR5 billion.

The program offers short-, medium- and long-term cash and non-cash facilities with terms of up to 10 years, covering working capital, asset and equipment purchases, point-of-sale receivables, and contract and project financing.
stories.lenovo: IDG: a SAR 5bn SME credit line funds device and IT purchases by Saudi SMEs, the core market for IDG's SMB channel; Lenovo should explore device-financing bundles with STC Bank. ISG: STC Bank's 28 partnerships, Huawei among them, make it a platform account where Lenovo is not yet visible.
stories.arabic: منشآت وبنك إس تي سي يوقعان اتفاقية تعاون لإطلاق محفظة تمويلية متوافقة مع الشريعة بقيمة تصل إلى 5 مليارات ريال لتمويل المنشآت الصغيرة والمتوسطة بآجال حتى 10 سنوات.

stories.title: ICAIRE Launches Program to Train 10,000 AI Leaders Across 53 Countries at UNESCO AI Ethics Forum
stories.published: SPA English 16 Sep 2026 17:45 KSA; Arabic 16:16 KSA
stories.summary: ICAIRE, the Riyadh-based international AI research and ethics centre under UNESCO auspices, launched a leadership programme at the 4th UNESCO Global Forum on the Ethics of AI in Riyadh, targeting 10,000 AI leaders across 53 countries. Separately, SDAIA awarded AI professional badges to 52 recipients.
bullets: ICAIRE launched the program in cooperation with ICESCO, in partnership with the Apolitical platform, and in coordination with the Saudi National Commission for Education, Culture and Science.
Over two years, the program aims to train 10,000 leaders and gradually expand to the 53 ICESCO member states, delivered entirely online.
The program has four tracks: AI fundamentals, advanced applications, AI ethics and governance, and the use of AI in strategic decision-making.
stories.lenovo: SSG/IDG: Riyadh is exporting AI-governance capacity to the Global South, including Africa, the government buyers Lenovo's META education and public-sector teams pursue. Lenovo can offer AI-PC and training-lab partnerships to ICAIRE programmes.
stories.arabic: المركز الدولي لأبحاث وأخلاقيات الذكاء الاصطناعي (آيكير) يطلق برنامجاً لتأهيل 10 آلاف قائد في الذكاء الاصطناعي في 53 دولة خلال المنتدى العالمي لأخلاقيات الذكاء الاصطناعي بالرياض.

stories.title: Wipro partners with Aramco and SAP to launch Wipro STO360™ for STO management
stories.published: 17 Sep 2026 13:10 KSA (earliest copy InvestyWise 13:08 KSA; BSE filing not retrieved)
stories.summary: Wipro launched STO360, an AI-driven tool for shutdown, turnaround and outage management built on SAP's Business Technology Platform. It was co-developed with Aramco, is listed on the SAP Store, and targets oil and gas, chemicals, mining and utilities.
bullets: Wipro STO360™ is built on SAP's Business Technology Platform to help asset-intensive organisations manage Shutdown, Turnaround, and Outage (STO) operations.
SAP has recognised Wipro STO360™ as an endorsed app available on the SAP Store.
Wipro's collaboration with Aramco spans over two decades, and Aramco Executive Vice President of Technology & Innovation Ahmad O. Al Khowaiter is quoted on the launch.
stories.lenovo: SSG/ISG: Aramco is co-developing industrial-AI tools with global SIs on SAP. Lenovo should position its SAP-certified infrastructure and edge compute (ThinkEdge) under Aramco plant-maintenance AI deployments through its Wipro and SAP alliances. Software only; hardware not addressed.
stories.arabic: ويبرو تطلق منصة STO360 المدعومة بالذكاء الاصطناعي لإدارة عمليات الإيقاف والصيانة الشاملة بالشراكة مع أرامكو وساب.

stories.title: AWS "unable to restore access" to data centers hit by Iran strikes
stories.published: DCD 16 Sep 2026 18:28 KSA (Google News pubDate)
stories.summary: DCD's follow-up adds Amazon's response: a spokesperson said suggestions that the data centres will not reopen contradict AWS status updates, but declined to say whether they will be rebuilt with new hardware. AWS says it is replacing the affected infrastructure, with a UAE update in the coming months and a Bahrain update in early 2027. Data held only in me-south-1 or mec1-az2 cannot be recovered.
bullets: AWS said it is unable to restore access to resources and data hosted exclusively in the mec1-az2 availability zone of its Middle East (UAE) me-central-1 region.
For the Bahrain me-south-1 region, AWS said damage spanned multiple availability zones and it will share further updates in early 2027.
An Amazon spokesperson disputed the suggestion that the impacted data centers will not reopen.
stories.lenovo: ISG: AWS will not commit to restoring capacity, so GCC customers face at least a two-quarter gap, the migration window Lenovo hybrid and DR offers must target now. If AWS rebuilds, that is a hyperscale hardware refresh in the region; supplier undisclosed.
stories.arabic: أمازون تعترض على القول بأن مراكز بياناتها المتضررة في البحرين والإمارات لن يُعاد تشغيلها، لكنها لم تؤكد إعادة بنائها بعتاد جديد، مع تحديث بشأن البحرين مطلع 2027.

stories.title: War damage forces costly rethink of AI infrastructure
stories.published: 17 Sep 2026 11:43 KSA (Google News pubDate 08:43 UTC)
stories.summary: AGBI cites an Atlantic Council fellow warning that attacks may deter investors and that hyperscalers must plan for deliberate strikes on several availability zones at once, pushing toward underground or blast-resistant facilities and air defence at higher cost. The UAE central bank relaxed its onshore-data rule during the conflict, and a companion AGBI piece weighs subsea data centres for the Gulf.
bullets: AWS said it could not restore access to data and resources held exclusively in its Bahrain cloud region or one UAE availability zone, six months after the damage.
Sona Muzikarova of Gravitas Advisors and the Atlantic Council said hyperscalers must adapt to a new threat model that includes deliberate attacks on several availability zones at a time.
Saudi Arabia shut its 1,200km East-West oil pipeline last weekend after drone attacks in the Riyadh and Medina regions.
stories.lenovo: ISG: Hardened, distributed, smaller-footprint designs favour modular, liquid-cooled edge and micro-DC offers (ThinkEdge, Neptune, TruScale) over single mega-campuses. Capex per MW will rise and some GCC projects will be re-phased, which affects 2027 ISG forecasts.
stories.arabic: أجبي: أضرار الحرب تفرض مراجعة مكلفة لبنية الذكاء الاصطناعي التحتية في الخليج، مع توجه نحو منشآت محصنة أو تحت الأرض وتخطيط لهجمات متزامنة على عدة مناطق توافر.

stories.title: Washington bets big on African fibre with $155-million Wiocc deal
stories.published: Reuters and DFC release 16 Sep 2026 (earliest timed copy Investing.com 20:38; Devdiscourse 22:07 KSA; TechCentral 17 Sep 08:38 KSA)
stories.summary: The US DFC will invest up to $155m of equity, its largest equity investment to date, in WIOCC, which runs subsea cable capacity, fibre and more than 40 core and edge data centres (Open Access Data Centres) across about 30 African countries. Vision Invest and Africa Finance Corporation are co-investing, with stakes undisclosed. The stated aim is to support US hyperscalers and provide an alternative to Huawei.
bullets: The US International Development Finance Corporation said it would invest up to US$155-million in Wiocc Group, which DFC CEO Ben Black called DFC's largest-ever equity investment.
DFC will provide the equity investment alongside Vision Invest and the African Finance Corporation.
Johannesburg-headquartered Wiocc operates undersea cables, fibre networks and data centres in more than 30 African countries.
stories.lenovo: ISG: US-backed, Saudi co-funded African DC capacity explicitly positioned against Huawei creates a vendor-selection opening for non-Chinese server and storage OEMs across OADC sites. Vision Invest is a Saudi counterparty the RHQ can approach. Hardware undisclosed, so this is an open ISG opportunity.
stories.arabic: مؤسسة تمويل التنمية الأمريكية تستثمر 155 مليون دولار في شركة WIOCC الأفريقية للبنية الرقمية بمشاركة فيجن إنفست السعودية ومؤسسة التمويل الأفريقية، كبديل لهواوي.

stories.title: Microsoft expands Agent 365 availability to the UAE as organizations move to govern AI agents at scale
stories.published: Zawya 16 Sep 2026 15:49 KSA (announced at GISEC Dubai)
stories.summary: Agent 365, Microsoft's control plane for monitoring, governing and securing AI agents built on Entra, Purview and Defender, will run from Microsoft's UAE data centre from October 2026. The announcement was made at GISEC Dubai, with Amr Kamel, GM of Microsoft UAE, speaking.
bullets: Microsoft announced at GISEC Global 2026 that Microsoft Agent 365 will be available to customers in the UAE data centre starting October.
Agent 365 covers observability, governance and security, extending Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Purview and Microsoft Defender protections to agents.
The release cites the UAE government's aim to move 50% of government sectors, services and operations to autonomous Agentic AI models within two years.
stories.lenovo: ISG/SSG: Microsoft keeps adding in-country AI services in the UAE even as AWS's UAE zone is down, strengthening its sovereign-cloud position. Lenovo's Azure Local (ThinkAgile MX) is the on-prem complement; pair it with the new Agent 365 local residency in UAE government bids. Hardware undisclosed.
stories.arabic: مايكروسوفت توسع إتاحة منصة Agent 365 لحوكمة وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي في الإمارات، مع تشغيلها من مركز بياناتها المحلي اعتباراً من أكتوبر 2026.

stories.title: Zain Kuwait partners with Schneider Electric
stories.published: Kuwait Times 16 Sep 2026 20:23 KSA
stories.summary: Zain Kuwait CTO Daaij Aloud and Schneider Gulf Cluster President Amel Chadli signed an agreement at Schneider's Middle East & Africa Innovation Summit in Abu Dhabi. It covers the operations and resilience of Zain's critical facilities, including AI-ready data centres, and AI-enabled asset management. No value was disclosed.
bullets: The agreement was announced at the Schneider Electric Innovation Summit Middle East & Africa 2026 in Abu Dhabi.
It was signed by Zain Kuwait Chief Technology Officer Daaij Aloud and Schneider Electric Gulf Cluster President Amel Chadli.
The companies also explored collaboration on AI-ready data centers, sustainability and decarbonization, AI-enabled Asset Performance Management, and Facilities Management and Operations Support.
stories.lenovo: ISG: Zain Kuwait is preparing its facilities for AI-ready data-centre loads. Schneider supplies power and cooling, but the compute layer is unassigned; compute undisclosed, so this is an open ISG opportunity via Lenovo-Schneider joint reference designs.
stories.arabic: زين الكويت توقع شراكة مع شنايدر إلكتريك لتعزيز مرونة منشآتها الحيوية بما فيها مراكز البيانات الجاهزة للذكاء الاصطناعي.

stories.title: du and QuantumGate bring post-quantum security to UAE cloud
stories.published: tbreak 16 Sep 2026 14:39 KSA (only source found; an earlier official release cannot be excluded)
stories.summary: QuantumGate, part of the ATRC's VentureOne, will deploy its post-quantum cryptography on du Tech's National Hypercloud for government and critical-infrastructure entities. Keys and cryptographic control stay inside the UAE.
bullets: QuantumGate's post-quantum security technology will run on du Tech's National Hypercloud, with the UAE Cyber Security Council endorsing the collaboration for government and critical entities.
du will commercialise the technology to government entities, while QuantumGate will provide technical support.
A QuantumGate and UAE Cyber Security Council study found 64% of organisations in selected GCC markets had allocated budgets for post-quantum migration.
stories.lenovo: ISG: Post-quantum requirements are entering UAE sovereign-cloud specifications. Lenovo ISG bids into du and government clouds should highlight quantum-safe firmware and hardware root of trust (XClarity/ThinkShield).
stories.arabic: دو وكوانتم جيت تطلقان حلول الأمن ما بعد الكمّي على السحابة الوطنية الفائقة في الإمارات للجهات الحكومية والبنية الحيوية.

stories.title: Dubai Government gains real-time view of cybersecurity posture with new DESC dashboard
stories.published: ITP 17 Sep 2026 11:56 KSA (Google News); Intelligent CISO 12:21 KSA
stories.summary: The Dubai Electronic Security Center and Microsoft built a Zero Trust dashboard that maps Microsoft security signals against the 13-domain Dubai Information Security Regulation and covers 37 types of security finding. After a pilot, two entities are onboarded and more than 80 more are being rolled out.
bullets: DESC and Microsoft announced the Zero Trust assurance dashboard at GISEC Global 2026, mapping Microsoft security signals against the 13-domain Dubai Information Security Regulation.
The dashboard covers 37 types of security finding, and its guidance can be exported in Arabic and English.
Following a pilot, two Dubai Government entities have been onboarded and the dashboard is being rolled out to more than 80 additional entities.
stories.lenovo: IDG: Dubai entities will be measured continuously on device compliance, which favours managed, secured PC fleets (ThinkShield, Intune-ready devices) in government refreshes.
stories.arabic: مركز دبي للأمن الإلكتروني ومايكروسوفت يطلقان لوحة معلومات آنية لقياس الوضع السيبراني للجهات الحكومية وفق نموذج الثقة الصفرية.

stories.title: Sheikh Khaled chairs first Abu Dhabi Executive Council meeting to use agentic AI platform
stories.published: Abu Dhabi Media Office 17 Sep 2026 10:02 KSA (Google News); Gulf Today 11:27 KSA
stories.summary: The Abu Dhabi Executive Council used its AI Committee System, an agentic AI platform, for the first time. The meeting also reviewed Phase 1 of the Liveability Strategy (more than 60 projects worth over AED 12bn). No platform vendor is named.
bullets: The meeting used the AI Committee System, an agentic AI platform, for the first time.
Phase 1 of the Abu Dhabi Liveability Strategy completed more than 60 major projects valued at more than Dhs12 billion, within a Dhs42 billion programme.
Sheikh Khaled approved expanding Al Ghad Nurseries from 3,000 to 12,000 seats by 2029.
stories.lenovo: IDG/ISG: Top-level government adoption of agentic AI in Abu Dhabi signals budgets for AI PCs and on-prem inference in government entities. Vendor undisclosed.
stories.arabic: الشيخ خالد بن محمد يترأس أول اجتماع للمجلس التنفيذي لإمارة أبوظبي يعتمد على منصة للذكاء الاصطناعي الوكيلي.

stories.title: Atos partners with GCH to open new AI-Driven Security Operations Center in the UAE
stories.published: GlobeNewswire 17 Sep 2026 05:00 KSA (16 Sep 22:00 ET)
stories.summary: Atos and Gulf Cyberfender Hub will open a Dubai security operations centre with local data residency, aligned to UAE security standards. It uses agentic AI and targets government and critical infrastructure. No value was disclosed.
bullets: The new Dubai-based SOC, opened with Gulf Cyberfender Hub, will provide sovereign security operations with local data residency.
It is designed to support compliance with UAE Information Assurance Standards and National Electronic Security Authority requirements.
The UAE SOC will work with the Atos Global Threat Research Center.
stories.lenovo: SSG/ISG: Atos is a services competitor and a potential infrastructure buyer. Lenovo should pitch the SOC's local compute and storage.
stories.arabic: أتوس وشركة GCH تفتتحان مركزاً لعمليات الأمن السيبراني مدعوماً بالذكاء الاصطناعي في الإمارات مع إقامة محلية للبيانات.

stories.title: Goldman's AI Server Forecast Sends Dell Stock Jumping
stories.published: Yahoo/GuruFocus 16 Sep 2026 22:15 KSA (Goldman note dated 16 Sep)
stories.summary: Goldman Sachs raised its server model to $1.5tn by 2030, with AI servers $1.3tn of that and traditional servers about $192bn; in Q2 AI servers Nvidia holds 42%, white-box makers 24% and Dell 17%, while Dell holds 29% of traditional servers. Dell shares climbed 4% on Wednesday. The $1.5tn, share and rating figures come from a secondary summary (KuCoin), not the Yahoo page, and the analyst's name was not confirmed.
bullets: Dell Technologies shares climbed 4% on Wednesday as investors focused on Goldman Sachs' higher projections for the AI server market.
Goldman research has estimated global AI investment at about $1 trillion in 2026, including roughly $581 billion in the U.S.
Dell's latest results showed a $95 billion AI server backlog and $60.9 billion of AI server orders.
stories.lenovo: ISG: The most-cited sell-side server model does not name Lenovo among the leaders, which shapes how META customers and partners perceive vendor momentum. ISG marketing should counter with Lenovo's own AI-server growth and META references (HUMAIN, center3, the Riyadh plant).
stories.arabic: غولدمان ساكس يرفع توقعاته لسوق الخوادم إلى 1.5 تريليون دولار بحلول 2030 منها 1.3 تريليون لخوادم الذكاء الاصطناعي، وسهم ديل يرتفع إلى مستوى قياسي.

stories.title: Apple May Return to Server Market With Nvidia Technology
stories.published: The Information 16 Sep 2026 16:00 KSA (Google News); MacRumors 16:53 KSA; Reuters 17:36 KSA
stories.summary: Apple is working on an AI inference server with two or four M8 Ultra chips and has discussed Nvidia NVLink Fusion to connect them. The target is 2029 and the project could be cancelled or ship without Nvidia; it would be Apple's first enterprise server since Xserve ended in 2011.
bullets: Apple is considering an AI server built around M8 series chips and has discussed incorporating Nvidia networking hardware, including NVLink Fusion.
The system would be sold to outside customers, bringing Apple back into a business it left when it discontinued Xserve in 2011.
The report places a potential release date in 2029, though the project could be canceled before then.
stories.lenovo: ISG: A long-dated but credible new entrant in enterprise inference servers. No META impact before 2029; monitor only.
stories.arabic: تقرير: أبل تدرس العودة إلى سوق الخوادم بخادم استدلال للذكاء الاصطناعي يعتمد على رقائق M8 Ultra، وأجرت محادثات مع إنفيديا، مع استهداف عام 2029.

stories.title: Banks provide $22 billion chip loan to Blackstone, Alphabet AI cloud venture, source says
stories.published: Reuters copy 16 Sep 2026 23:34 KSA (Investing.com); Bloomberg original 16 Sep; headline updated after publication
stories.summary: Ten banks led by Goldman, SMBC, Barclays, BNP Paribas and Scotiabank are lending to the Crux AI venture to buy Google TPUs, with the loan secured by the chips and customer contracts. Blackstone has committed $5bn of equity toward 500MW of capacity in 2027.
bullets: A group of 10 banks including Goldman Sachs, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corp, Barclays, BNP Paribas and Bank of Nova Scotia is providing a $22 billion chip loan to Crux AI.
Crux AI has secured an initial $5 billion equity investment from Blackstone, while Google will provide its custom Tensor Processing Units, software and services.
The venture plans to bring its first 500 megawatts of capacity online in 2027, with the debt used to buy Google TPUs and backed by those chips and customer contracts.
stories.lenovo: ISG: Chip-collateralised debt is now a $22bn-scale asset class, the financing template GCC neoclouds (and HUMAIN's Goldman-advised raise) will copy. Lenovo financial services should be ready to structure hardware-backed deals. Supplier: Google TPUs (ODM undisclosed).
stories.arabic: عشرة بنوك تقدم قرضاً بقيمة 22 مليار دولار مضموناً بالرقائق لمشروع كروكس للذكاء الاصطناعي التابع لبلاكستون وألفابت لشراء معالجات TPU من جوجل.

stories.title: Nebius Announces GPU Price Increases, Shares Rise Over 9% in Pre-Market Trading
stories.published: First coverage Stocktwits 17 Sep 2026 02:31 KSA (Google News); KuCoin 04:23 KSA; no official Nebius notice found, unconfirmed by the company
stories.summary: Reported Nebius GPU hourly prices rise from 1 October: H100 $3.85 to $4.50, H200 $4.50 to $5.40, B200 $7.15 to $8.50 and B300 $7.85 to $9.50, with AMD Genoa vCPU pricing up 25%. It would be Nebius's second rise since May; no official notice was found and nebius.com/prices still shows the old rates, so treat as unconfirmed by the company.
bullets: On-demand pricing for NVIDIA B300 GPUs will rise 21% to $9.50 per hour starting October 1.
H100 pricing will rise from $3.85 to $4.50 per GPU-hour, H200 from $4.50 to $5.40, and B200 from $7.15 to $8.50.
AMD EPYC Genoa CPU rates will increase by 25% from $0.012 per vCPU-hour to $0.015.
stories.lenovo: ISG: Rental GPU prices are rising, which improves the own-versus-rent economics of on-prem AI infrastructure for META enterprises and supports Lenovo's AI-factory and TruScale TCO pitch.
stories.arabic: نيبيوس ترفع أسعار تأجير وحدات معالجة الرسومات بنحو 20% اعتباراً من أول أكتوبر، في ثاني زيادة منذ مايو.

stories.title: Generac Stock Soars 45% After Amazon Locks In $8 Billion AI Data Center Generator Deal
stories.published: CNBC 17 Sep 2026 00:02 KSA (Google News); Bloomberg 01:08; Reuters 01:34
stories.summary: Generac will supply $2.4bn of backup generators for 2027-28 deliveries, and Amazon gets warrants for up to 1,693,745 Generac shares worth about $340m that vest as Amazon's payments rise toward $8bn. Generac rose as much as 45% after hours.
bullets: Generac issued Amazon a warrant for roughly 1.69 million shares worth about $340 million.
Initial generator deliveries are set to total $2.4 billion across 2027 and 2028, per a filing Generac made with the SEC.
Roughly 307,954 of the warrant shares vested immediately, with the rest tied to Amazon's generator spending up to an $8 billion ceiling.
stories.lenovo: ISG: Hyperscalers are locking up power equipment years ahead, as they already do with memory. Long-lead DC equipment constrains META build timelines too, so ISG delivery commitments should reference site-power readiness.
stories.arabic: أمازون تحصل على حق شراء أسهم في جنراك ضمن صفقة مولدات احتياطية لمراكز البيانات بقيمة 2.4 مليار دولار، وسهم جنراك يقفز أكثر من 40%.

stories.title: OpenAI says CEO Altman will attend Trump's state dinner for Xi
stories.published: CNBC 17 Sep 2026 00:32 KSA (Google News); Reuters 16 Sep 23:11 KSA
stories.summary: Sam Altman, Tim Cook and Jensen Huang are expected at the state dinner for the Trump-Xi summit around 24 Sep, where AI is expected to be high on the agenda. USTR Jamieson Greer has played down hopes of a comprehensive deal.
bullets: OpenAI said on Wednesday that CEO Sam Altman will attend U.S. President Donald Trump's state dinner for Chinese President Xi Jinping.
stories.lenovo: ISG/supply chain: Any change to US AI-chip or tool export rules would reset the terms for META sovereign AI deals and for Lenovo's China-linked supply chain. This is the key policy event of next week.
stories.arabic: سام ألتمان وتيم كوك وجنسن هوانغ يحضرون عشاء الدولة لقمة ترامب وشي في واشنطن، مع توقع أن يتصدر الذكاء الاصطناعي جدول الأعمال.

stories.title: Lenovo Modernizes Virtualization Infrastructure for an AI-Ready Future
stories.published: Lenovo StoryHub 16 Sep 2026 16:00 KSA (RSS 13:00 UTC)
stories.summary: Lenovo launched the ThinkAgile VX850 V4 for highly virtualised and in-memory workloads, with Standard Deploy, Premier Deploy and Premier Deploy Plus options (Plus adds a one-year infrastructure health assessment). It also validates Express Solutions for Hyper-V, Azure Local (ThinkAgile MX V4), Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization and Nutanix.
bullets: The expanded portfolio includes the Lenovo ThinkAgile VX850 V4, purpose-built for highly virtualized and demanding in-memory workloads.
Three deployment options will be available: Standard Deploy, Premier Deploy, and Premier Deploy Plus.
Premier Deploy Plus adds extended post-deployment assistance and a one-year infrastructure health assessment.
stories.lenovo: ISG/SSG: This is the product answer to the week's GCC resilience demand, as customers exit single-cloud and VMware-lock-in positions. META ISG should put it straight into the AWS-exit and DR campaigns.
stories.arabic: لينوفو تطلق منظومة ThinkAgile VX850 V4 وخدمات نشر جديدة لتحديث البنية التحتية الافتراضية وجعلها جاهزة للذكاء الاصطناعي.

stories.title: China's Huawei says AI chip demand outstrips supply as it steps up Nvidia challenge
stories.published: Reuters 17 Sep 2026 05:40 KSA (Google News); SCMP 05:26 KSA; TrendForce 17 Sep
stories.summary: At Huawei Connect in Shanghai, Huawei said AI-chip demand exceeds supply, so overseas sales stay limited. Ascend 960DT moves up three quarters to Q1 2027 and 960PR to Q3 2027, with a new generation each year after that, and Atlas 860 and 960 SuperPoDs arrive in 2027 alongside a new Peerium architecture. TrendForce reports DeepSeek plans at least 160,000 Ascend 950DT chips.
bullets: Huawei plans to have its Ascend 960DT chip ready in the first quarter of 2027, three quarters earlier than previously planned.
Huawei intends to release a new generation of Ascend chips every year, with the 970 and 980 following in 2028 and 2029.
Huawei unveiled a computing architecture called Peerium, designed eventually to let as many as 1 million processors operate as a single system.
stories.lenovo: ISG: Huawei's limited export supply caps near-term Ascend competition in GCC AI tenders, an opening for Lenovo's Nvidia and AMD platforms. A 2027 Ascend ramp, however, restores Huawei as a sovereign-AI alternative where US licences are slow.
stories.arabic: هواوي تعلن أن الطلب على رقائقها للذكاء الاصطناعي يفوق المعروض وتقدّم موعد إطلاق معالج Ascend 960DT إلى الربع الأول من 2027، مع إبقاء المبيعات الخارجية محدودة.

stories.title: TikTok is now asking Kenyan creators for their tax information
stories.published: tech-ish 16 Sep 2026 15:24 KSA
stories.summary: Under Kenyan tax law, TikTok is collecting creators' tax details to withhold 5% from residents and 20% from non-residents, joining Meta and YouTube. No start date has been given.
bullets: Kenya has applied withholding tax on creator income since 1st July 2023, at 5% for residents and 20% for non-residents.
Meta told Facebook and Instagram creators in November 2025 that 5% would be deducted from payouts from 1 January 2026.
Creators on turnover tax at 3% with annual turnover between KES 1 million and KES 25 million face a monthly 5% withholding that exceeds their annual bill.
stories.lenovo: Low. African digital-tax enforcement is spreading to platforms, a compliance trend that also touches device e-commerce in Kenya.
stories.arabic: تيك توك تطلب من صناع المحتوى في كينيا بياناتهم الضريبية تمهيداً لاقتطاع ضريبة بنسبة 5% للمقيمين و20% لغير المقيمين.

stories.title: Tencent Cloud and AI Singapore Connect Singapore's AI Talent with Real-World Industry Challenges
stories.published: PR Newswire Asia 17 Sep 2026 11:01 KSA
stories.summary: Tencent Cloud and AI Singapore are running a hackathon from 16 Sep to 3 Nov with DBS, Keppel, NTU and Ryde. Separately, Tencent Cloud MENA reports rising Saudi demand (see story 02).
bullets: The AI CAN DO IT Tencent Cloud Hackathon Singapore 2026 runs from 16 September to 3 November 2026.
Each registered participant receives 1,000 credits for Tencent CodeBuddy, with submissions closing on 16 October 2026 and shortlisted teams announced on 23 October.
Cash prizes of S$10,000, S$5,000 and S$2,000 go to the top three winners.
stories.lenovo: Low. It follows Tencent Cloud International's ecosystem-building playbook, which it may repeat in KSA.
stories.arabic: تينسنت كلاود و"إيه آي سنغافورة" تطلقان مسابقة تربط المواهب بتحديات قطاعات الأعمال الحقيقية.

stories.title: ZTE, Antel Validate Symmetric 50G PON in Latin America
stories.published: The Fast Mode 17 Sep 2026 01:53 KSA
stories.summary: ZTE and Uruguay's Antel validated symmetric 50G PON. Separately, ZTE's Nubia launched a second-generation Doubao AI phone using CXMT memory (Caixin, SCMP).
bullets: ZTE and Antel, Uruguay's largest telecommunications operator, completed the first validation of symmetric 50G PON technology in Latin America during the Antel Summit 2026.
The validation achieved the convergence and evolution of three generations of PON technologies: GPON, 10G PON, and 50G PON.
ZTE says it will deepen its collaboration with Antel to drive the evolution of all-optical access networks.
stories.lenovo: Low. Telco access equipment, where ZTE competes with Huawei in META operators.
stories.arabic: زد تي إي وأنتل تتحققان من تقنية الشبكات الضوئية المتماثلة بسرعة 50 غيغابت في أمريكا اللاتينية.

stories.title: ColorOS 17 Unveiled: Natural AI Photo Editing, Smoother System Animations, and Smart Productivity Tools
stories.published: NokiaPowerUser 17 Sep 2026 07:15 KSA (Google News shows 16 Sep 18:29, also in window)
stories.summary: ColorOS 17 adds AI photo editing powered by a Da Vinci visual model with six sub-models, native 2K ProXDR, AI Notes and a system-level AI assistant. The China rollout starts 8 Oct, according to The Tech Outlook (not stated on the NokiaPowerUser page).
bullets: The gallery and camera upgrade is powered by the Da Vinci Large Model of Visual Understanding, which coordinates six specialized sub-models.
Native 2K ProXDR enhances dynamic range across supported displays directly in the gallery viewer.
The update adds AI Notes and the OPPO AI Heart Ball, a system-level, hardware-aware AI assistant.
stories.lenovo: Motorola: Software differentiation ahead of Oppo's Find X10 launch on 22 Sep, which competes with Motorola in GCC retail.
stories.arabic: أوبو تكشف واجهة ColorOS 17 بأدوات ذكاء اصطناعي جديدة، مع بدء طرحها في الصين في 8 أكتوبر.

stories.title: Honor WIN Tablet teased with flagship design, launching soon
stories.published: Huawei Central 16 Sep 2026 17:32 KSA
stories.summary: Pre-orders are open on Honor's official Mall and the tablet will likely debut next month, not with the Magic 9 series. Earlier details point to a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 with an active cooling fan, unconfirmed by Honor.
bullets: Honor's WIN tablet will likely debut next month and not with the Magic 9 series, and is available for pre-order on the official Mall.
The tablet can use the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chip with an upgraded built-in active cooling fan.
The fan reduces core temperature by more than 10°C.
stories.lenovo: IDG: A performance-tablet competitor to Lenovo's Legion and Yoga tablets.
stories.arabic: هونر تشوق لجهازها اللوحي WIN بتصميم رائد ومروحة تبريد مدمجة، مع فتح باب الطلب المسبق.

stories.title: Hisense Crashes the Party With Four New Boom Portable Bluetooth Speakers
stories.published: eCoustics 17 Sep 2026 07:03 KSA
stories.summary: Hisense's Boom family comprises three portable speakers (FlexBoom, WeBoom, VoyageBoom) plus the larger Party Thunder Pro at $399.99 and up to 620W. The headline says four speakers.
bullets: The Boom family includes three portable speakers, FlexBoom, WeBoom and VoyageBoom, plus the larger Party Thunder Pro.
FlexBoom offers a dual driver configuration, 40 watts of output, up to 20 hours of playback and an IP67 rating.
Party Thunder Pro is priced at $399.99 and rated for up to 620 watts of output.
stories.lenovo: Marginal consumer-electronics adjacency.
stories.arabic: هايسنس تطلق أربع مكبرات صوت محمولة جديدة من سلسلة Boom.

stories.title: Samsung Chip Profit Seen at 370 Trillion Won as DDR5 Prices Jump 5.5-Fold
stories.published: Seoul Economic Daily 17 Sep 2026 04:00 KSA (10:00 KST); the figures first appeared in untimed 16 Sep pieces that may be pre-window
stories.summary: The 64GB DDR5 server RDIMM contract price is $1,500 as of mid-September, up from $272 a year earlier (5.5 times). Samsung's chip division sees 2026 operating profit of up to 370 trillion won, up from 330 trillion won guided in June, with 3Q operating profit forecast at 107.4 trillion won. Foreign investors net sold 11.9462 trillion won of Korean shares over six sessions (9-16 Sep), including 6.2945 trillion won of Samsung Electronics.
bullets: Samsung Electronics' Device Solutions division management raised its operating profit outlook for this year to as much as 370 trillion won.
As of the 15th, the fixed contract price for 64-gigabyte DDR5 server modules (RDIMM) reached $1,500, 5.5 times the $272 recorded a year earlier.
Third-quarter operating profit is forecast at 107.4 trillion won, which would be the company's first quarter above 100 trillion won.
stories.lenovo: ISG: A 64GB RDIMM at $1,500 means memory now dominates the cost of a ThinkSystem AI or virtualisation node. META ISG quotes older than 30 days are likely under water, so re-validate pricing on open sovereign and enterprise bids.
stories.arabic: سيول إيكونوميك ديلي: سعر عقود ذاكرة الخوادم DDR5 سعة 64 غيغابايت يبلغ 1500 دولار بارتفاع 5.5 أضعاف خلال عام، وسامسونج تتوقع أرباحاً تشغيلية لقطاع الرقائق تصل إلى 370 تريليون وون.

stories.title: Citi Believes Global Memory Supply Tightness Will Persist Until 2031, and the Price Increase Cycle Is Expected to Remain Strong
stories.published: NAI500 17 Sep 2026 06:31 KSA (secondary report; Citi analyst and note date not given)
stories.summary: Citi estimates DRAM blended ASP rises of 242.4% in 2026 and 23.1% in 2027, with 2027 DRAM bit demand up 30.2% against supply up 18.8%. It sees an HBM supply gap of about 21% in 2027 and 36% in 2028, and some long-term agreements being extended from three to five years. These are all Citi estimates from a secondary report.
bullets: Citi expects HBM bit demand to rise 62% year over year to 75.2 billion Gb in 2027, with a supply gap of about 21% that could widen to about 36% in 2028.
Citi expects global DRAM bit demand to grow about 30.2% in 2027 against supply growth of 18.8%, a market gap of about 8.7%.
After DRAM blended average selling prices surged 242.4% in 2026, they may still rise 23.1% year over year in 2027.
stories.lenovo: ISG/IDG: A second major house, after Goldman, now calls a multi-year shortage. That supports 3-5-year LTAs and pricing clauses tied to a memory index in META framework deals, as opposed to fixed escalators.
stories.arabic: سيتي: شح إمدادات الذاكرة عالمياً سيستمر حتى 2031، مع توقع ارتفاع متوسط أسعار DRAM بنسبة 23.1% في 2027 وتمديد بعض العقود طويلة الأجل إلى خمس سنوات.

stories.title: Memory Price Surge Erases Ultra-Low-Cost Smartphones
stories.published: Chosun Ilbo English 16 Sep 2026 18:36 KSA
stories.summary: Global shipments of phones under $100 fell about 60% YoY in 2Q26. Omdia reports Africa's smartphone shipments down 7% YoY in 2Q and sub-$100 models down 34%, with senior analyst Manish Prabhukumar saying makers can no longer build low-cost phones profitably. IDC says mobile DRAM and NAND prices are up more than 300% YoY and memory exceeds 64% of component cost on phones at $99 or less.
bullets: Shipments of smartphones priced under $100 in the second quarter fell by approximately 60% from the same period last year.
Omdia reported Africa's smartphone shipments fell 7% year-on-year in the second quarter, while devices priced under $100 dropped 34%.
According to IDC, smartphone DRAM and NAND prices have surged over 300% from a year ago, and memory exceeded 64% of component costs in smartphones priced at $99 or less.
stories.lenovo: Motorola/IDG: Motorola's entry tier in Africa, Pakistan and Egypt is structurally uneconomic at current memory costs. META should shift mix to $150+ moto g and push carrier-financing models in these markets.
stories.arabic: ارتفاع أسعار الذاكرة يقضي على الهواتف الذكية منخفضة التكلفة، مع تراجع شحنات الهواتف دون 100 دولار في أفريقيا بنسبة 34% في الربع الثاني وفق أومديا.

stories.title: Foreign funds sell Korea chip giants despite IB optimism on memory cycle
stories.published: Chosunbiz 17 Sep 2026 00:00 KSA (published_time 16 Sep 21:00Z)
stories.summary: A Goldman note of 14 Sep (analyst not named) keeps Buy ratings with targets of 490,000 won for Samsung and 3.5m won for SK hynix, expecting 3Q DRAM and NAND ASPs up about 20% QoQ and 2027 HBM ASPs up about 100%. Foreign investors net sold 11.927 trillion won on KOSPI from 9 to 16 Sep, which Meritz (Lee Jin-woo) and iM Securities (Lee Sang-heon) attribute to liquidity, not the chip cycle.
bullets: Foreigners were net sellers on the main bourse for six straight sessions from Sept. 9 to 16, with total net sales of 11.927 trillion won.
Foreign investors net sold 5.8539 trillion won of SK hynix and 4.3869 trillion won of Samsung Electronics, about 86% of total foreign net sales on the KOSPI.
Goldman Sachs kept buy ratings on both companies, with target prices of 490,000 won for Samsung Electronics and 3.5 million won for SK hynix.
stories.lenovo: ISG/IDG: Equity weakness is not a signal of price relief, since the sell side still sees rising ASPs. Supply-chain teams should not delay 2027 commitments waiting for a correction.
stories.arabic: المستثمرون الأجانب يبيعون أسهم سامسونج وإس كيه هاينكس بنحو 11.9 تريليون وون رغم توقعات غولدمان ساكس بارتفاع أسعار الذاكرة 20% في الربع الثالث.

stories.title: SK Hynix weighs US memory options as buyers lock in 2027 supply
stories.published: DigiTimes 17 Sep 2026 06:54 KSA (paywalled, teaser only; follows a pre-window Reuters exclusive)
stories.summary: SK hynix is weighing US production options, reportedly including Intel's Ohio site, while customers move earlier to secure 2027 supply. SK hynix said no plans are confirmed.
bullets: SK Hynix is keeping its US memory options open as customers move earlier to secure 2027 supply, with tightening availability raising pressure on memory makers to consider additional capacity.
stories.lenovo: ISG/IDG: Buyers moving early to lock in 2027 supply is the operational signal that matters: allocation windows for 2027 are closing now.
stories.arabic: إس كيه هاينكس تدرس خيارات لإنتاج الذاكرة في الولايات المتحدة، فيما يسارع المشترون لتأمين إمدادات عام 2027.

stories.title: CXMT cashes in on the DRAM shortage — and takes aim at HBM
stories.published: DigiTimes 17 Sep 2026 11:19 KSA (paywalled, teaser only)
stories.summary: Sharply higher profits and pricing power at China's CXMT are funding expansion into LPDDR6 and HBM. SCMP separately reports Chinese phone makers turning to CXMT, including Nubia's use of CXMT LPDDR5X.
bullets: ChangXin Memory Technologies is emerging from the memory shortage with sharply higher profits and greater pricing power, giving it more resources to expand into LPDDR6 and high-bandwidth memory.
stories.lenovo: ISG/IDG, supply chain: CXMT is becoming a credible second source for LPDDR and a future HBM source. That is relevant to Lenovo's China-built PCs and phones, but it adds export-control and customer-acceptance questions for META government deals.
stories.arabic: شركة CXMT الصينية تستفيد من نقص ذاكرة DRAM لتحقيق أرباح قوية وتتجه للتوسع في ذاكرة LPDDR6 وHBM.

stories.title: Festive smartphone sales face steepest decline in decade in wake of memory chip crisis
stories.published: Mint 17 Sep 2026 03:25 KSA (05:55 IST)
stories.summary: India's July-September smartphone sales are projected down 25% to about 36m units from 48m, per IDC India data. Memory costs have made even the cheapest devices about 40% more expensive, and the quarter would be the weakest since September 2016.
bullets: High memory chip prices are making even the most affordable devices 40% more expensive.
July-September quarter smartphone volumes are projected to decline 25% to about 36 million units from 48 million a year earlier, per data collated from IDC India.
This would be the worst sales level for India's $45 billion smartphone economy since September 2016.
stories.lenovo: Motorola: India is Motorola's growth engine and a supply benchmark for Pakistan and Africa. Demand destruction at the entry tier confirms the META mix shift in story 31.
stories.arabic: مبيعات الهواتف الذكية في الهند خلال موسم الأعياد تتجه لأكبر تراجع في عقد بنسبة 25% بسبب أزمة رقائق الذاكرة.

stories.title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Price To Hike By Rs 12,000 in India: Check New Prices
stories.published: My Mobile India 17 Sep 2026 07:08 KSA (Google News); Gizbot and Moneycontrol about 12:45 KSA
stories.summary: From 20 Sep, the Galaxy S26 12+256GB model rises from Rs 87,999 to Rs 99,999 and the 12+512GB from Rs 1,07,999 to Rs 1,19,999. The article gives no reason; the memory-cost link is inferred from the wider market, not stated in the source.
bullets: The new pricing is effective from September 20, 2026, for both storage variants.
The 12GB + 256GB variant goes from Rs 87,999 to Rs 99,999.
The 12GB + 512GB variant goes from Rs 1,07,999 to Rs 1,19,999.
stories.lenovo: Motorola/IDG: A flagship mid-cycle price rise by the market leader gives Motorola and Lenovo cover for their own memory-driven price actions in META.
stories.arabic: سامسونج ترفع سعر هاتف جالاكسي S26 في الهند بمقدار 12 ألف روبية اعتباراً من 20 سبتمبر.

stories.title: Xiaomi Laptop Price Hike: From Redmi Book Pro 16 to Redmi Book Pro 14; Check All Models With Upgraded Rates
stories.published: LatestLY 17 Sep 2026 09:18 KSA (Google News); Technetbook ~16 Sep 23:01 KSA (alert time); Notebookcheck 12:43 CET
stories.summary: In China only, at least seven Xiaomi laptop models rose in price, with the Redmi Book Pro 16 (2025) going from 4,699 to 5,399 yuan and the 2026 Pro 14 and Pro 16 up 500 yuan each. Increases range from 400 to 700 yuan; Xiaomi has not explained them, and the memory-cost link is press inference.
bullets: Citing Gizmochina, the price increases range between 400 and 700 yuan in the Chinese market.
The Redmi Book Pro 16 2025 rose from 4,699 yuan to 5,399 yuan, the steepest increase at 700 yuan.
The Redmi Book Pro 16 2026 moved from 7,399 yuan to 7,899 yuan, and the Redmi Book Pro 14 2026 from 7,199 yuan to 7,699 yuan.
stories.lenovo: IDG: A direct PC competitor is repricing its whole range for memory. Lenovo's own IDG price actions in META are being matched in the market, which limits share risk from further increases.
stories.arabic: شاومي ترفع أسعار حواسيبها المحمولة في الصين بما يشمل Redmi Book Pro 16 وPro 14، وسط ارتفاع تكاليف الذاكرة.

stories.title: Micron to scale up semiconductor assembly, testing in India next year
stories.published: Business Standard (PTI) 17 Sep 2026 09:46 KSA
stories.summary: At SEMICON India, Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said Sanand will assemble and test tens of millions of chips this year and, as printed, hundreds of billions next year (likely a transcription error). Micron has more than 7,000 direct employees in India, and commercial production at Sanand began earlier this year.
bullets: Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said the company will assemble and test tens of millions of chips at Sanand this year.
Micron has been in India for seven years and employs more than 7,000 people there directly.
Commercial production at Micron's Sanand, Gujarat facility began earlier this year.
stories.lenovo: IDG/supply chain: Back-end memory capacity in India is a supply option for Lenovo's India manufacturing and a closer logistics source for META. It does not add wafer supply.
stories.arabic: مايكرون تعتزم توسيع عمليات تجميع واختبار أشباه الموصلات في مصنعها بالهند بشكل كبير العام المقبل.
